_comment: External metabolic pathway resources linked from /metabolic_pathways.
This file is the single source for the resource section, the metric card and
the client search index, in the same way data/ai/ai_resources.json drives /ai.
Add a resource here and it appears in all three places at once.
Only databases that carry a maize organism build belong here. Two further
sections were retired on 2026-09-13: 'Pathway and reaction databases' listed
the general Reactome, BioCyc, PlantCyc and KEGG sites, which say the same
thing as the maize builds above them, and 'Enzyme nomenclature and kinetics'
listed IUBMB, BRENDA and Expasy ENZYME, which no search on this page can
reach and whose data files are not among its downloads.
Every URL is the one the host actually serves after redirects, not the older
address it still honours. Recording the destination saves every reader a
redirect and keeps the link working when the old host is eventually retired.
'group' selects the section. 'maize' marks a resource that is specific to Zea
mays rather than a general reference; every resource here now carries it.

groups.title: Maize pathway databases
groups.lead: Pathway databases that carry a maize organism build.

resources.name: CornCyc at the Plant Metabolic Network
resources.description: The maintained CornCyc build: maize metabolic pathways, enzymes and reactions predicted with the E2P2 pipeline and curated by PMN. This is the resource that replaced the CornCyc instances MaizeGDB used to host.

resources.name: Plant Reactome
resources.description: Curated and orthology-projected plant pathways, including Zea mays, with pathway diagrams, comparative analysis across species and expression overlays.

resources.name: KEGG maize pathway maps
resources.provider: Kyoto Encyclopedia of Genes and Genomes
resources.description: The KEGG pathway maps built for Zea mays (organism code zma), each linking to the maize genes assigned to it.
